title: Width of a block minterm
statement: Let $m\ge 7$, choose a block $b\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and assign a sign to each of its $2m$ coordinates. The corresponding block minterm has width exactly $2m$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a natural number with $7\le m$
